prompt: Create an original 90 second bossa nova instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: nylon guitar, shaker, upright bass, electric piano. Style: syncopated guitar chords with gentle Latin groove. Tempo approximately 116 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A smooth and relaxing instrumental jazz piece featuring acoustic guitar, electric piano, bass, and light drums. It has a mellow and sophisticated feel.
description.zh: 一首流畅轻松的器乐爵士乐曲，以原声吉他、电钢琴、贝斯和轻柔的鼓点为特色。营造出一种醇厚而精致的氛围。
